summary.text: Roth McElvain is the Republican candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 5 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat John Tomko.
He has held an at-large seat on the Palmyra R-I School District board since 2019, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: McElvain won the August 4, 2026 Republican primary for District 5, defeating Lyndon Bode, Justin Barnhart and Rose Ghattas.
